reason.en: The lesson diagnoses a recorded two-part sequence by reading a trace, and no trace recorded from a board has been written for it.
reason.es: La lección diagnostica una secuencia registrada de dos piezas leyendo una traza, y no se ha escrito para ella una traza registrada desde una placa.

instead.en: Complete it in Simulation, where the trace is the evidence you read.
instead.es: Complétela en Simulación, donde la traza es la evidencia que usted lee.
